info.title: ECHOS API
info.description: Decision-support demo API for ECHOS (not a diagnostic tool). **No authentication**: for local demos only, bound to 127.0.0.1. Lists are paginated with `limit` and `offset`. Errors have the shape `{"error": {"status": 404, "message": "..."}}`.

schema.title: Response Statuses Api Patients  Pid  Statuses Get

get.description: ISO weeks with a stored weekly report for this patient (the UI builds a missing one instead of probing for a 404).

schema.title: Response Weekly Available Api Patients  Pid  Reports Weekly Available Get

post.description: Build (or rebuild) the weekly PDF and store it; nothing is emailed.

Build (or rebuild) the weekly PDF and email it to the CLINICIAN. Respects alerts.send_real (false = outbox only, DryRun).
Without `force` a week that was already sent is not sent again.
Acknowledge an alert (stops the escalation timer). Idempotent.

get.description:
The "I have seen this" link in alert e-mails: signed (HMAC) and expiring, no login. Acknowledges the alert it names (idempotent) and shows a small page
that says nothing about the person. Forged / malformed tokens all get the same answer.

post.description: Mark an alert as handled (closes its open tasks).
Exchange a token for a role. The token is then sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Failed attempts are rate-limited.

get.description: Is authentication on, and which role does this request have? (role is null when not logged in)

post.description:
Ingestion contract for ANY source (device, hub, emulator): a batch of activity / vitals / accel / heartbeat events with DATA timestamps.
Idempotent: an exact repeat counts as a duplicate. If ECHOS_INGEST_TOKEN is set, send it as X-Echos-Token. Limits (config `ingest`): 413 too large / too many events, 411 no Content-Length, 403 unregistered device, 429 rate limit (Retry-After).

get.description: Data mode (replay / emulator / live), emulator state and, per patient, how fresh each stream is.

post.description: Control the labelled device emulator: load | play | pause | speed | fall.

get.description: Every detector, agent and infrastructure part: what it does, what it must never do, and whether it is running.
The message bus: who told whom what (newest first).

schema.title: Response Agent Messages Api Agents Messages Get

get.description: Every detector, agent and infrastructure part: live status, how many actions it has logged and its latest one.

schema.title: Response Agents Summary Api Agents Summary Get

get.description: What the agents did, newest first, from the tables they write. With `patient_id` + `day` (one case) the detector steps are included and the order can be oldest first.

schema.title: Response Agents Activity Api Agents Activity Get

get.description: The Case Investigator's file for a changed or urgent day (latest day if none is given); null when that day has none (a normal day).

schema.title: Response Case File Api Patients  Pid  Case Get

get.description: Which agents the Team Planner called for on a day (latest day if none is given) and why; null when no plan was recorded.

schema.title: Response Team Plan Api Patients  Pid  Team Plan Get

post.description: Resend ONE outbox row now (uses this API's mailer: DryRun unless alerts.send_real). A row that is already SENT is never re-sent (409).

Inject a SisFall fall window for a patient at the current simulated time. The response states which SisFall subject it came from and whether
that subject was in the training set of the model used by the Fall worker (the replay model excludes the held-out subjects) and of the final model.

get.description: Server-Sent Events: alert, day_status, report_ready, agent_health, outbox_status. Comment heartbeat every 15 s. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

parameters.name: max_seconds

schema.description: close the stream after this many seconds (tests)
schema.title: Max Seconds

parameters.description: close the stream after this many seconds (tests)

schema.title: Response Agents Health Api Agents Health Get

post.description: Fault demo: SIGKILL a worker; the supervisor restarts it. Refused unless config api.allow_kill is true.

get.description: Flags the UI needs: whether agent kill is enabled and whether mail is real (never secrets).
